blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. JV Ejercito visited on Thursday the North-South Commuter Railway (NSCR) Valenzuela Depot and Metro Manila Subway System project site with Transportation Secretary Giovanni Lopez, along with representatives from the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) and the Embassy of Japan, and project contractors, to inspect the progress of the country’s major railway projects. Ejercito was accompanied by his uncle, Fernando Reyes, whom he credits for inspiring his fascination with trains. He recalled how, during their visits to the United States when he was younger, they would watch and marvel at the long cargo trains passing by. Ejercito said he […]...
